## Coca (CR 8)

A vaguely dragon-like creature, apparently made of many mismatched vegetable parts, lurches towards you with a hungry light in the hollow orbits of its bare skull.  

**XP** 4,800  
NE Medium undead  
**Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +18  


**Defense**


**AC** 21, touch 14, flat-footed 17 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +7 natural)  
**hp** 144 (12d8+48)  
**Fort** +7, **Ref** +7, **Will** +11  
**Immune** undead traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., climb 10 ft.  
**Melee** bite +16 (1d6+6 plus grab), 2 claws +15 (1d4+6)  
**Special Attacks** shadow bolt (DC 19), swallow whole (1d4+4 negative energy, AC 13, 10 hp)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 12th, concentration +15)  


At will—detect anxieties (DC 16), frightful form (DC 19), prestidigitation (DC 14)  

1/day—fear (DC 18), phantasmal killer (DC 18)  



**Statistics**


**Str** 22, **Dex** 17, Con —, **Int** 14, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 17  
**Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +15; **CMD** 28 (32 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Critical Focus, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Initiative, Tiring Critical, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Climb +29, Intimidate +18, Knowledge (local) +17, Perception +18, Sense Motive +18, Stealth +18  
**Languages** Common, any language it spoke while alive  


**Special Abilities**



**Frightful Form (Sp)** As a standard action, a coca can use a special form of its detect anxieties spell-like ability, drawing forth an image of the deepest fears of a creature within 10 feet and transforming its body into a freakish phantasmagoria that frightens the target in the same round. The target takes 2d8+9 damage, or half as much if it succeeds on a Will saving throw. A creature failing its save is also frightened for 1 minute, though it can attempt a new saving throw each round to end that effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.  

**Shadow Bolt (Su)** As a standard action, a coca can fire a bolt of shadowy energy at a creature it can see within 60 feet. The target must make a Fortitude saving throw, taking 24 2d10+11 negative energy damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target fails the saving throw, it is also stunned 1 for 1 round. The save DC is Charisma-based.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any, inhabited settlements  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** standard
